en.title: GoJet — Controlled links, files and sharing workflows
en.description: GoJet brings controlled links, QR codes, files, text sharing, Bio pages, analytics and custom domains into one governed workspace.
en.h1: Share with control. Operate with clarity.
en.lede: Create and operate links, QR codes, files, text shares and Bio pages with workspace controls, analytics and safety boundaries that remain server-authoritative.
points: Build public sharing workflows without turning security controls into client-side promises.
Use signed product capabilities, workspace governance and documented APIs from one consistent platform boundary.

zh.title: GoJet — 可控的链接、文件与分享工作流
zh.description: GoJet 将短链接、二维码、文件、文本分享、Bio、分析与自定义域名纳入统一且可治理的工作空间。
zh.h1: 分享更可控，运营更清晰。
zh.lede: 在统一工作空间中创建和运营链接、二维码、文件、文本分享与 Bio 页面，并保持服务端权限、分析和安全边界。
points: 构建公开分享流程，同时不把安全控制降级为前端承诺。
通过已经签署的产品能力、工作空间治理与文档化 API 保持一致的平台边界。

en.title: GoJet Products — Sharing and link operations
en.description: Explore GoJet links, QR, files, text sharing, Bio, analytics, smart routing and custom-domain capabilities.
en.h1: Product capabilities built around controlled sharing
en.lede: Each GoJet product surface maps to a signed V10 capability and keeps authorization, lifecycle and risk decisions on the server.
points: Choose the sharing primitive that matches the task.
Keep analytics, workspace controls and safety rules connected across product surfaces.

zh.title: GoJet 产品 — 分享与链接运营
zh.description: 了解 GoJet 的短链接、二维码、文件、文本分享、Bio、分析、智能路由与自定义域名能力。
zh.h1: 围绕可控分享构建的产品能力
zh.lede: 每个 GoJet 产品页面都对应已经签署的 V10 能力，并保持服务端授权、生命周期与风险决策。
points: 根据任务选择合适的分享方式。
让分析、工作空间控制与安全规则在不同产品表面保持一致。

en.title: Controlled short links — GoJet
en.description: Create managed short links with lifecycle controls, routing, A/B destinations, UTM mutation and auditable history.
en.h1: Short links with explicit lifecycle and routing controls
en.lede: GoJet link authority covers CRUD, custom codes, status behavior, passwords, expiry, click limits, one-time links, batch operations and export.
points: Routing and A/B destinations stay bound to destination-risk fingerprints.
UTM mutation happens only after the safety decision, and history remains attributable.

zh.title: 可控短链接 — GoJet
zh.description: 创建具备生命周期控制、路由、A/B 目标、UTM 处理与可审计历史的短链接。
zh.h1: 具备明确生命周期与路由控制的短链接
zh.lede: GoJet 链接能力覆盖 CRUD、自定义短码、状态行为、密码、到期、点击上限、一次性、批量与导出。
points: 路由与 A/B 目标始终绑定目标风险指纹。
UTM 只在安全裁决之后执行，历史变更保持可归因。

en.title: Managed QR codes — GoJet
en.description: Create, list, share and download QR codes backed by the same authoritative target and access controls as GoJet resources.
en.h1: QR codes backed by real resource authority
en.lede: GoJet generates real PNG and SVG QR output and keeps sharing and download behavior aligned with the owning resource permissions.
points: Generated output is independently decodable rather than a visual placeholder.
QR lifecycle actions remain tied to workspace authorization.

zh.title: 可管理二维码 — GoJet
zh.description: 创建、列出、分享与下载二维码，并保持与 GoJet 资源一致的目标和访问控制。
zh.h1: 由真实资源权限支撑的二维码
zh.lede: GoJet 生成真实的 PNG 与 SVG 二维码，并让分享和下载行为与资源权限保持一致。
points: 生成结果可被独立解码，而不是视觉占位图。
二维码生命周期操作继续受工作空间授权约束。

en.title: Controlled file sharing with mandatory malware scanning — GoJet
en.description: Share files through quarantine, mandatory ClamAV scanning, publication and authorized download lifecycle controls.
en.h1: File sharing that fails closed before publication
en.lede: Files move through quarantine and mandatory malware scanning before publication; missing, stale, failed or uncertain scan authority does not become an allowed download.
points: ClamAV is a required production dependency, not an optional enhancement.
Password, expiry, download limits and retention remain server-authoritative.

zh.title: 强制恶意软件扫描的可控文件分享 — GoJet
zh.description: 通过隔离、强制 ClamAV 扫描、发布与授权下载生命周期来分享文件。
zh.h1: 发布之前默认失败关闭的文件分享
zh.lede: 文件先进入隔离区并完成强制恶意软件扫描；扫描缺失、过期、失败或不确定时都不会获得下载许可。
points: ClamAV 是正式环境强制依赖，而不是可选增强。
密码、到期、下载上限与保留期始终由服务端裁决。

en.title: Controlled text sharing — GoJet
en.description: Publish text shares with access controls, lifecycle states and permanent noindex handling for public UGC resources.
en.h1: Text sharing with clear access and lifecycle states
en.lede: GoJet text shares preserve access control, expiry and lifecycle status while public user-generated resources remain outside search acquisition.
points: Password and lifecycle checks are enforced by the server.
Public text routes remain noindex and outside Website and Docs sitemaps.

zh.title: 可控文本分享 — GoJet
zh.description: 通过访问控制、生命周期状态与永久 noindex 策略发布文本分享。
zh.h1: 访问与生命周期状态清晰的文本分享
zh.lede: GoJet 文本分享保持访问控制、到期与生命周期状态，同时公开 UGC 资源不进入搜索获客集合。
points: 密码与生命周期检查由服务端执行。
公开文本路由保持 noindex，并排除在 Website 与 Docs sitemap 之外。

en.title: Link in Bio management — GoJet
en.description: Build and publish Bio pages while keeping public Bio resources noindex and child destinations subject to current risk authority.
en.h1: Bio pages with governed child destinations
en.lede: GoJet Bio editing and publication are workspace-controlled; public Bio pages stay noindex and their child links remain subject to current destination-risk decisions.
points: A destination change invalidates stale safety authority.
Opt-in Bio indexing remains deferred in GoJet V10.

zh.title: Link in Bio 管理 — GoJet
zh.description: 构建并发布 Bio 页面，同时保持公开 Bio noindex，并让子目标持续接受当前风险裁决。
zh.h1: 对子目标保持治理的 Bio 页面
zh.lede: GoJet Bio 编辑与发布受工作空间控制；公开 Bio 页面保持 noindex，子链接继续遵循当前目标风险裁决。
points: 目标变化会使旧的安全裁决失效。
Bio 可选索引在 GoJet V10 中仍为延期能力。

en.title: Link analytics and reconciliation — GoJet
en.description: Measure link events and dimensions with Redis transport, MySQL aggregates and idempotent reconciliation authority.
en.h1: Analytics designed for recoverable link operations
en.lede: GoJet analytics carries click events through reviewed transport, aggregate and reconciliation paths so reporting can recover without inventing business success.
points: Redis event transport and MySQL aggregates are part of the signed authority.
Reconciliation is idempotent and repeatable.

zh.title: 链接分析与对账 — GoJet
zh.description: 通过 Redis 事件传输、MySQL 聚合和幂等对账统计链接事件与维度。
zh.h1: 面向可恢复链接运营的分析能力
zh.lede: GoJet 分析通过经过验证的事件传输、聚合与对账链路处理点击数据，让报表能够恢复而不虚构业务成功。
points: Redis 事件传输与 MySQL 聚合属于已签署能力。
对账过程保持幂等且可重复执行。

en.title: Smart link routing and A/B safety — GoJet
en.description: Route by reviewed conditions and A/B weights while applying destination-risk authority to every reachable target.
en.h1: Smart routing without bypassing destination safety
en.lede: Geo, device, language, source and A/B routing remain part of the same target-fingerprint and risk decision chain as the primary destination.
points: Every reachable target is risk-evaluated before routing can allow it.
Stale fingerprints and uncertain provider states fail closed.

zh.title: 智能链接路由与 A/B 安全 — GoJet
zh.description: 按审核后的条件和 A/B 权重路由，同时让每个可达目标都接受目标风险裁决。
zh.h1: 不绕过目标安全的智能路由
zh.lede: 地域、设备、语言、来源与 A/B 路由和主目标一样，统一进入目标指纹与风险裁决链路。
points: 每个可达目标都必须先通过风险评估。
过期指纹与不确定的提供商状态默认失败关闭。

en.title: Custom domains with independent safety axes — GoJet
en.description: Bind custom domains through entitlement, ownership, DNS, HTTPS and domain-risk checks that remain independently authoritative.
en.h1: Custom domains with explicit eligibility and safety checks
en.lede: A domain becomes usable only when entitlement, ownership, DNS, HTTPS and risk axes all permit it; tickets and payments do not bypass those independent checks.
points: TXT ownership, HTTPS readiness and domain-risk state remain separate decisions.
Manual entitlement approval has explicit limits and expiry.

zh.title: 具备独立安全轴的自定义域名 — GoJet
zh.description: 通过资格、所有权、DNS、HTTPS 与域名风险检查绑定自定义域名，各轴保持独立权威。
zh.h1: 具备明确资格与安全检查的自定义域名
zh.lede: 只有资格、所有权、DNS、HTTPS 与风险轴都允许时域名才可使用；工单或支付都不能绕过这些独立检查。
points: TXT 所有权、HTTPS 就绪和域名风险保持独立裁决。
人工资格审批具有明确限额和到期时间。

en.title: GoJet Solutions — Workflows for marketing, creators, teams and developers
en.description: See how signed GoJet capabilities combine into marketing, creator, team and developer sharing workflows.
en.h1: Workflows built from real GoJet capabilities
en.lede: Solution pages connect already-signed capabilities into practical workflows without inventing unavailable product behavior or outcomes.
points: Marketing combines campaigns, links, UTM, A/B and analytics.
Creators, teams and developers use the same workspace and safety authority from different task entry points.

zh.title: GoJet 解决方案 — 营销、创作者、团队与开发者工作流
zh.description: 了解已经签署的 GoJet 能力如何组合成营销、创作者、团队与开发者分享工作流。
zh.h1: 由真实 GoJet 能力组合出的工作流
zh.lede: 解决方案页面只组合已经签署的能力，不虚构尚未提供的产品行为或结果。
points: 营销场景组合 Campaign、链接、UTM、A/B 与分析。
创作者、团队和开发者从不同任务入口共享同一工作空间与安全权威。

en.title: Marketing link workflows — GoJet
en.description: Operate campaign links with UTM mutation, A/B destinations and analytics while preserving destination-risk ordering.
en.h1: Marketing links with measurable, governed routing
en.lede: Campaign organization, UTM handling, A/B destinations and analytics work together without moving safety decisions behind marketing transformations.
points: UTM changes happen after risk authority permits the target.
Campaign and analytics data remain workspace-scoped.

zh.title: 营销链接工作流 — GoJet
zh.description: 通过 UTM、A/B 目标与分析运营 Campaign 链接，同时保持目标风险裁决顺序。
zh.h1: 可衡量且受治理的营销链接
zh.lede: Campaign 组织、UTM、A/B 目标与分析协同工作，同时不把安全裁决放到营销变换之后。
points: UTM 处理只在风险权威允许目标之后发生。
Campaign 与分析数据保持工作空间隔离。

en.title: Creator sharing workflows — GoJet
en.description: Combine Bio pages, QR codes and controlled links while preserving workspace permissions and destination safety.
en.h1: Creator workflows with controlled public sharing
en.lede: Build a Bio, connect managed links and distribute QR codes while keeping public resources and child destinations inside their signed governance boundaries.
points: Public Bio stays noindex in V10.
QR and links keep their owning resource permissions.

zh.title: 创作者分享工作流 — GoJet
zh.description: 组合 Bio、二维码与可控链接，同时保持工作空间权限和目标安全。
zh.h1: 具备公开分享控制的创作者工作流
zh.lede: 构建 Bio、连接受管理链接并分发二维码，同时让公开资源与子目标保持在已签署治理边界内。
points: V10 的公开 Bio 保持 noindex。
二维码与链接继续遵循各自资源权限。

en.title: Team link governance — GoJet
en.description: Use workspace membership, roles and audited operations to govern shared link resources across teams.
en.h1: Team workflows with server-authoritative workspace roles
en.lede: Workspace owners, administrators, members and viewers operate through server-side tenant and RBAC decisions, with high-risk actions remaining auditable.
points: The last owner is protected by workspace lifecycle rules.
Admin and workspace permissions remain separate authorities.

zh.title: 团队链接治理 — GoJet
zh.description: 通过工作空间成员、角色与可审计运营治理团队共享的链接资源。
zh.h1: 由服务端角色权威支撑的团队工作流
zh.lede: Workspace owner、administrator、member 与 viewer 都通过服务端租户和 RBAC 裁决操作，高风险动作保持可审计。
points: 工作空间生命周期规则保护最后一个 owner。
Admin 与 Workspace 权限保持独立权威。

en.title: Developer automation workflows — GoJet
en.description: Use released workspace API keys and generic outbound webhooks with scope, secret rotation, retry and SSRF-safe delivery controls.
en.h1: Developer automation with scoped keys and governed webhooks
en.lede: GoJet V10 includes signed workspace API-key and generic outbound-webhook authority; payment callbacks remain a separate ingress contract.
points: API key raw secrets are returned once and are not recoverable from storage.
Outbound webhooks use signed delivery and fail closed against unsafe destinations and DNS rebinding.

zh.title: 开发者自动化工作流 — GoJet
zh.description: 使用已发布的工作空间 API Key 与通用出站 Webhook，并保持 scope、密钥轮换、重试和 SSRF 安全。
zh.h1: 使用受限密钥和受治理 Webhook 的开发者自动化
zh.lede: GoJet V10 已签署工作空间 API Key 与通用出站 Webhook 权威；支付回调仍是独立入口合同。
points: API Key 原始密钥只返回一次，存储后不可恢复。
出站 Webhook 使用签名投递，并对不安全目标和 DNS rebinding 默认失败关闭。

en.title: GoJet Developers — API and automation entry
en.description: Start with released GoJet API-key and webhook capabilities, then use the bilingual static Docs for checked API reference and self-hosting guidance.
en.h1: Build against released GoJet V10 interfaces
en.lede: Developer acquisition points to checked, released API capabilities and the P18 static documentation set rather than inventing undocumented methods.
points: Workspace API keys and generic outbound webhooks are released under P17 authority.
The API reference and native self-hosting guide live in the bilingual P18 Docs build.

zh.title: GoJet 开发者 — API 与自动化入口
zh.description: 从已发布的 API Key 与 Webhook 能力开始，并通过双语静态文档查看校验后的 API 与自托管指南。
zh.h1: 基于已经发布的 GoJet V10 接口构建
zh.lede: 开发者入口只指向已经校验并发布的 API 能力与 P18 静态文档，不虚构未记录的方法。
points: 工作空间 API Key 与通用出站 Webhook 已由 P17 签署发布。
API Reference 与原生自托管指南位于 P18 双语静态 Docs。

en.title: GoJet Pricing — Plans, quotas and entitlement boundaries
en.description: Review GoJet plan and quota concepts without fabricated prices; authoritative commercial values must come from the public plan source.
en.h1: Plans and quotas without invented commercial data
en.lede: GoJet’s billing and entitlement model is released, but this static Website does not fabricate a price or availability snapshot when authoritative public plan data is not embedded.
points: Billing grants use structured server-side entitlements and quotas.
Custom-domain entitlement remains conjunctive with ownership, DNS, HTTPS and risk checks.

zh.title: GoJet 定价 — 套餐、配额与资格边界
zh.description: 了解 GoJet 套餐和配额概念，不虚构价格；正式商业数值必须来自权威公开套餐数据源。
zh.h1: 不虚构商业数据的套餐与配额说明
zh.lede: GoJet 计费和资格模型已经发布，但当静态 Website 没有嵌入权威公开套餐数据时，不会虚构价格或可用性快照。
points: 计费权益和配额使用结构化服务端数据。
自定义域名资格仍需同时满足所有权、DNS、HTTPS 与风险检查。

en.title: GoJet Security — Reviewed control boundaries
en.description: Understand GoJet authentication, destination risk, mandatory file scanning, domain safety, abuse and administrative control boundaries.
en.h1: Security controls described by their verified boundaries
en.lede: GoJet documents the controls that have signed implementation authority without making certification, compliance or absolute-security claims.
points: Sessions, CSRF/Origin, OAuth and Turnstile controls are server-authoritative.
Destination/domain risk and mandatory ClamAV file scanning fail closed when authority is missing or uncertain.

zh.title: GoJet 安全 — 已验证的控制边界
zh.description: 了解 GoJet 身份验证、目标风险、强制文件扫描、域名安全、滥用治理与管理员控制边界。
zh.h1: 按照已验证边界说明安全控制
zh.lede: GoJet 只描述已经取得签署实现权威的控制，不作认证、合规或绝对安全承诺。
points: Session、CSRF/Origin、OAuth 与 Turnstile 控制由服务端裁决。
目标/域名风险与强制 ClamAV 文件扫描在权威缺失或不确定时默认失败关闭。

en.title: GoJet Guides — Approved product workflows
en.description: Read task-focused Website guides that link to signed product behavior and the deeper bilingual GoJet Docs.
en.h1: Task guides grounded in released product authority
en.lede: Website guides provide concise acquisition and task context; implementation details and checked API references remain in the P18 Docs surface.
points: Only published guide records enter internal acquisition and the guides sitemap set.
Withdrawn guides return 410 and unknown guides return 404.

zh.title: GoJet 指南 — 已批准的产品工作流
zh.description: 阅读以任务为中心的 Website 指南，并连接到已签署产品行为与更深入的双语 GoJet Docs。
zh.h1: 建立在已发布产品权威上的任务指南
zh.lede: Website 指南提供简明获客与任务上下文；实现细节和校验后的 API Reference 继续由 P18 Docs 承载。
points: 只有已发布指南记录进入内部获客和 guides sitemap。
撤回指南返回 410，未知指南返回 404。

en.title: Guide: Build a controlled link-sharing workflow — GoJet
en.description: A concise guide to combining managed links, routing, destination-risk checks and workspace governance without bypassing signed safety authority.
en.h1: Build a controlled link-sharing workflow
en.lede: Start with the resource authority, keep every reachable destination inside current risk checks, and use workspace roles and audit history for operational changes.
points: Create and govern the link before applying routing or campaign transformations.
Treat pending, review, blocked, stale or unavailable risk authority as non-navigable until the signed system permits it.

zh.title: 指南：构建可控链接分享工作流 — GoJet
zh.description: 简要说明如何组合受管理链接、路由、目标风险检查与工作空间治理，同时不绕过已签署安全权威。
zh.h1: 构建可控链接分享工作流
zh.lede: 先确定资源权威，让每个可达目标持续接受当前风险检查，再通过工作空间角色和审计历史治理运营变更。
points: 先创建并治理链接，再应用路由或 Campaign 变换。
风险状态为 pending、review、blocked、stale 或 unavailable 时保持不可导航，直到已签署系统允许。

en.title: About GoJet — Product operating principles
en.description: Learn the maintained GoJet V10 product identity and the principles behind server authority, fail-closed safety and evidence-driven releases.
en.h1: GoJet is built around explicit authority and evidence
en.lede: GoJet V10 is a Greenfield implementation whose product behavior is defined by its approved specification pack and proven by current-repository evidence.
points: Server-side decisions remain authoritative for tenant, security and lifecycle state.
A capability is not described as released until its owning node and evidence authorize that claim.

zh.title: 关于 GoJet — 产品运行原则
zh.description: 了解 GoJet V10 的产品身份，以及服务端权威、默认失败关闭和证据驱动发布原则。
zh.h1: GoJet 围绕明确权威与可验证证据构建
zh.lede: GoJet V10 是 Greenfield 实现，产品行为由批准的规范包定义，并由当前仓库证据证明。
points: 租户、安全和生命周期状态始终由服务端裁决。
能力只有在所属节点和证据授权后才会被描述为已发布。

en.title: Contact GoJet — Accountable support channel
en.description: Contact GoJet through the reviewed public contact flow with validation, bot protection, rate controls and persistent result states.
en.h1: Contact the GoJet team through a reviewed channel
en.lede: The public contact path routes a reason to the support authority while preserving validation, Turnstile, rate limiting and secret-safe handling.
points: A contact submission is a request, not automatic entitlement or resource authority.
Success and error outcomes remain persistent and reviewable in the user flow.

zh.title: 联系 GoJet — 可追责的支持渠道
zh.description: 通过经过验证的公开联系流程与 GoJet 沟通，保留校验、机器人防护、限流和持久结果状态。
zh.h1: 通过经过验证的渠道联系 GoJet 团队
zh.lede: 公开联系路径把原因路由到支持权威，同时保留校验、Turnstile、限流与密钥安全处理。
points: 联系提交只是请求，不会自动授予资格或资源权威。
成功与错误结果在用户流程中保持持久且可复核。

en.title: GoJet Service Terms
en.description: Current GoJet service terms for the V10 product surface.
en.h1: Service Terms
en.lede: These terms define the current GoJet service relationship for the V10 product surface and are maintained as a versioned legal content record.
points: Use of GoJet remains subject to applicable product limits and acceptable-use rules.
Superseded or withdrawn legal records follow explicit HTTP lifecycle behavior rather than soft deletion.

zh.title: GoJet 服务条款
zh.description: 适用于 GoJet V10 产品表面的当前服务条款。
zh.h1: 服务条款
zh.lede: 本条款定义 GoJet V10 当前服务关系，并作为版本化法律内容记录维护。
points: GoJet 使用仍受适用产品限制和可接受使用规则约束。

en.description: Understand GoJet abuse reporting, evidence, decision and recovery boundaries for public resources.
en.h1: Abuse Policy and Reporting
en.lede: GoJet accepts public abuse reports, preserves evidence and applies reviewed resource decisions through auditable trust and administrator authority.
points: External reports do not automatically remove or restore a resource.
